title: All Hell Breaks Lose When DCF Shows Up To Collect Baby From Mom
description:
On January 26th, 2023. Police and DCF showed up to a home to remove a newborn baby. According to reports the mom had removed the baby from the hospital without adequate care provided to the baby & without knowledge of the hospital. Reports also states that "allegations of environmental hazards and threat harm were received by the department" in regards to living conditions for the child. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
